source: Rockstar Games store (stable 2013–present) + community endgame cost research

endgame_cost_history.endgame_description: Kosatka ($3.7M TCO) + Oppressor Mk2 ($5.2M TCO) + Nightclub ($3M) + Bunker ($3M) + Acid Lab ($750k) + Agency ($2M) + Garment Factory ($2.4M) + misc
endgame_cost_history.notes: True endgame 2025: ~$35M GTA$. That is 4.4 Megalodon Shark Cards = $437.50 USD. In 2013, $437.50 bought you more than 23× the endgame content. GTA Online's real-money endgame cost has grown 23× in 12 years.

analysis.summary: Reaching GTA Online endgame via Shark Cards cost ~$18.75 USD in 2013. It costs ~$437.50 USD in 2025-2026. That is a 23.3× increase in real-money cost over 12 years, while Shark Card denominations have not changed.
